table.apple_score: CREATE TABLE apple_score(asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, overall REAL)
table.asset_uuid: CREATE TABLE asset_uuid(asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, uuid TEXT NOT NULL, match_method TEXT, confidence REAL, cloud_guid TEXT, fingerprint TEXT)
table.labels: CREATE TABLE labels(asset_id INTEGER, category TEXT, term TEXT, score REAL)
table.persons: CREATE TABLE persons(asset_id INTEGER, person TEXT)
table.provenance: CREATE TABLE provenance(k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)

table.cluster_faces: CREATE TABLE cluster_faces( face_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, cluster_id INTEGER NOT NULL, cos_to_centroid REAL NOT NULL)
table.cluster_meta: CREATE TABLE cluster_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)
table.clusters: CREATE TABLE clusters( cluster_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, size INTEGER NOT NULL, /* faces */ n_assets INTEGER NOT NULL, /* distinct assets */ n_days INTEGER NOT NULL, /* distinct capture days */ first_day TEXT, /* ISO date, display only */ last_day TEXT, centroid BLOB NOT NULL, /* float32 x 512, L2-normalized */ rep_face_ids TEXT NOT NULL, /* JSON [face_id,...] by cos desc */ claimed_person_id INTEGER, /* set by /api/person/create */ updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, dismissed INTEGER)

table.decisions: CREATE TABLE decisions( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('keep','cut')), bucket TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

table.variant_groups: CREATE TABLE variant_groups( group_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, notes TEXT )
table.variant_members: CREATE TABLE variant_members( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, group_id INTEGER NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('original','edit','unknown')), edit_type TEXT, confidence REAL, role_confidence REAL, method TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL )

table.assignments: CREATE TABLE assignments( face_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, person_id INTEGER NOT NULL, source TEXT, /* 'manual' | 'propagated' | 'apple' */ confidence REAL, confirmed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
table.faces: CREATE TABLE faces( face_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, bbox_json TEXT, det_score REAL, embedding BLOB, /* float32 x 512 */ created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, embed_model TEXT, embed_det INTEGER, embed_provider TEXT, embed_run TEXT)
table.persons: CREATE TABLE persons( person_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE, is_protected INTEGER DEFAULT 0, source TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, is_pet INTEGER DEFAULT 0)
table.processed: CREATE TABLE processed( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, n_faces INTEGER NOT NULL, processed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
table.rejections: CREATE TABLE rejections( person_id INTEGER NOT NULL, face_id INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(person_id, face_id))

index.idx_gps: CREATE INDEX idx_gps ON assets(gps_lat, gps_lon)
index.idx_year_month: CREATE INDEX idx_year_month ON assets(year, month)

table.assets: CREATE TABLE assets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, filepath TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, filename TEXT, file_size_bytes INTEGER, file_mtime INTEGER, file_sha256 TEXT, -- deferred (content hashing iteration) mime_type TEXT, extension TEXT, year INTEGER, month INTEGER, -- EXIF / metadata capture_timestamp INTEGER, gps_lat REAL, gps_lon REAL, camera_make TEXT, camera_model TEXT, lens_model TEXT, iso INTEGER, shutter_speed REAL, -- exposure time in seconds aperture REAL, -- f-number width_pixels INTEGER, height_pixels INTEGER, orientation INTEGER, -- Live Photo / shared album detection is_live_photo_still INTEGER, -- deferred (pairing iteration) is_live_photo_video INTEGER, -- deferred live_photo_partner_id INTEGER, -- deferred is_shared_album INTEGER, -- Quality / similarity phash TEXT, -- deferred (hashing iteration) dhash TEXT, -- deferred blur_laplacian REAL, -- deferred -- Video-specific duration_seconds REAL, -- deferred (video iteration) -- Processing tracking processed_at INTEGER, processing_errors TEXT )

table.processed: CREATE TABLE processed( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, processed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
table.scores: CREATE TABLE scores( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, max_score REAL, top_class TEXT)

table.live_pairs: CREATE TABLE live_pairs( still_asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, mov_asset_id INTEGER UNIQUE, method TEXT, confidence REAL, built_at INTEGER)

table.renders: CREATE TABLE renders( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, render_path TEXT NOT NULL, uuid TEXT, render_bytes INTEGER, built_at INTEGER)

table.processed: CREATE TABLE processed ( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, ts REAL )
table.vec_images: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE vec_images USING vec0( asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, embedding FLOAT[1152] )
table.vec_images_chunks: CREATE TABLE "vec_images_chunks"(chunk_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,size INTEGER NOT NULL,validity BLOB NOT NULL,rowids BLOB NOT NULL)
table.vec_images_info: CREATE TABLE "vec_images_info" (key text primary key, value any)
table.vec_images_rowids: CREATE TABLE "vec_images_rowids"(rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,id,chunk_id INTEGER,chunk_offset INTEGER)
table.vec_images_vector_chunks00: CREATE TABLE "vec_images_vector_chunks00"(rowid PRIMARY KEY,vectors BLOB NOT NULL)

table.clusters: CREATE TABLE clusters( cluster_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lat REAL, lon REAL, venue TEXT, generated_at INTEGER, venue_lat REAL, venue_lon REAL)
table.summaries: CREATE TABLE summaries( period_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, facts_json TEXT, venues_json TEXT, prose TEXT, generated_at INTEGER)

table.vault: CREATE TABLE vault(asset_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, marked_at INTEGER NOT NULL, note TEXT)
